# Acceptra

> Acceptra is an AI college admissions counselor for students, parents, school counselors and school officials: essay feedback, a college list matched to you, scholarships, activities, SAT practice and every deadline in one place, checked against 2,200+ schools.

Acceptra opens soon. It is taking sign-ups on a waitlist: sign up at https://acceptra.ai (the Join waitlist button). Schools can book a walkthrough from the For schools section of the same page.

## Who it is for

- Students applying to US colleges
- Parents helping them
- School counselors, who see where each student stands
- School officials bringing AI college counseling to a high school

## What it does

- Essay feedback, line by line: it marks up what the student wrote, and every note is a suggestion they accept or reject. It never writes the essay or invents a detail about the student's life.
- A college list matched to the student's grades, budget and goals, sorted into reach, target and safety.
- Scholarships the student qualifies for.
- Research, competitions and summer programs that fit the student.
- Official SAT practice questions, with an explanation of each mistake.
- Every school's deadlines, next to the student's own tasks.
- Two 20-minute calls a month with a mentor who got in recently, on paid plans.

## Pricing

- Free: $0 a month. 20 questions a month, 1 essay draft with feedback, a school list for 3 schools, deadlines and tasks.
- Monthly: $20 a month, cancel any time. Unlimited questions and essay feedback, two mentor calls a month, deadlines, tasks and scholarships.
- Yearly: $99 a year, one payment from junior spring through decision day. Everything in Monthly, plus activities and summer programs.

## FAQ

### Does Acceptra write the essay for me?

No. It reads what you wrote, marks it up line by line, and suggests changes you accept or reject. It never invents a detail about your life. When something is missing, it asks you, so every word stays yours.

### Where does the school data come from?

From published admissions, cost and aid figures for each school, checked for changes every day. Nothing is estimated or made up, and a number we don’t have is shown as missing rather than guessed.

### Is my data sold or used for advertising?

No. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for advertising. Acceptra isn’t open yet; before it opens we will publish an updated privacy policy that covers accounts and essays, and email everyone on the waitlist.
